scenes.title: Predator Attack and Loss of Family
scenes.description: A barracuda attacks the family's home while the parents try to protect their eggs; the mother and almost all the eggs are lost, leaving Marlin alone searching desperately and calling out for his wife.

scenes.title: Nemo mocked for his fin
scenes.description: Other young fish notice Nemo's smaller fin and tease him, asking what's wrong with him, before Marlin explains it's his 'lucky fin'.

scenes.title: Marlin embarrasses Nemo
scenes.description: Marlin publicly scolds Nemo in front of his friends for nearly swimming into open water, humiliating him and saying he's not ready for school, leading Nemo to shout that he hates him.

scenes.title: Nemo scolded for swimming off
scenes.description: Nemo swims out toward a boat against his father's warnings, and Marlin frantically chases and yells at him to come back.

scenes.title: Nemo taken by divers
scenes.description: Divers suddenly grab Nemo and take him away in a boat while Marlin desperately tries to save him and screams his name in panic and grief.

scenes.title: Marlin searches in despair
scenes.description: Marlin frantically searches for the boat that took his son, crying out and asking strangers for help, clearly in deep distress.

scenes.title: Marlin's story upsets the sharks
scenes.description: Marlin tearfully explains that his son was taken by divers, and the sharks react with sympathy while one mentions never knowing his own father.

scenes.title: Shark frenzy over blood
scenes.description: Dory gets a small bloody scratch and the smell of blood sends the sharks, especially Bruce, into a frenzy where he tries to eat her despite his 'fish are friends' pledge, chasing Marlin and Dory in fear for their lives.

scenes.title: Bruce the shark's frenzy
scenes.description: A shark smells blood and goes into a wild feeding frenzy, chasing Marlin and Dory through an exploding submarine wreck while Nemo is separated from his father.

scenes.title: Nemo trapped in the tank
scenes.description: Nemo is dropped into the dentist's fish tank, frightened and crying, surrounded by strange fish who startle him, while he desperately asks about his father and realizes he's far from home.

scenes.title: Fish tank narrates dentist's root canal
scenes.description: The tank fish watch and describe a human patient's root canal being done by the dentist off-screen, using dental jargon and reacting to the patient's yelps; it's comic and not directly threatening to the fish characters.

scenes.title: Darla the fish killer / Nemo stuck in pipe
scenes.description: The other fish reveal that Darla accidentally killed her last pet fish, and Nemo panics realizing he'll be given to her; he then gets physically stuck in a tank pipe and struggles anxiously to free himself while calling for his father.

scenes.title: Mask lost, Dory's confusion
scenes.description: Dory sleep-talks and gets confused, briefly scaring another character with a shark warning, then the pair lose the diving mask that was their only clue to finding Nemo, upsetting Marlin.

scenes.title: Anglerfish encounter in the dark trench
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory are drawn toward a glowing light that turns out to be a lure on a scary deep-sea anglerfish, which suddenly chases them through pitch darkness before they escape.

scenes.title: Duck! Marlin's scare
scenes.description: Something startles Marlin suddenly, making him think he has died, before it turns out fine and everyone celebrates.

scenes.title: Ring of Fire initiation
scenes.description: Nemo is pressured to swim through a ring of bubbles as an initiation dare from the tank fish, a mild scary-sounding but harmless moment.

scenes.title: Marlin asks Dory to leave
scenes.description: Marlin tries to tell Dory he wants to continue alone, hurting her feelings and making her upset before he takes it back.

scenes.title: Jellyfish sting encounter
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory encounter a small jellyfish and get stung while trying to look at it.

scenes.title: Jellyfish field hopping game gone wrong
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory play a dangerous game hopping across a field of jellyfish to avoid stinging tentacles, and Dory gets badly stung and collapses, seemingly dying, until Marlin manages to revive her.

scenes.title: Gill trapped, Nemo panics
scenes.description: Gill gets stuck in a filter/machine while Nemo tries to help him escape, and everyone shouts in panic before he's freed.

scenes.title: Marlin unconscious after jellyfish
scenes.description: Marlin lies unconscious after an earlier jellyfish encounter and Crush the turtle tries to wake him up, worrying he might be badly hurt before he comes to.

scenes.title: Marlin blames himself, Dory disoriented
scenes.description: Dory seems dazed and mumbling, and Marlin worries and blames himself, which a sensitive child might find upsetting though nothing bad actually happens.

scenes.title: Tale of Marlin's journey
scenes.description: Nigel tells Nemo an exaggerated, comic retelling of his father's adventures fighting sharks and jellyfish to find him; it is danger being retold, not happening now.

scenes.title: Nemo stuck in the filter
scenes.description: Nemo swims into the tank filter and gets jammed inside its gears while the other fish scramble to pull him free; it's tense for a moment but he's rescued unharmed.

scenes.title: Krill swarm rush
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory get caught in a swarm of tiny krill and must swim away quickly, a brief moment of confusion and mild danger.

scenes.title: Trapped inside the whale
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory find themselves swallowed inside a whale's mouth, and Marlin panics, believing they are trapped and will never find Nemo.

scenes.title: Inside the whale
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory are trapped inside a whale's mouth/throat, frightened and arguing about what to do while the whale roars around them, before being forced to let go and swept out.

scenes.title: Nemo nearly falls, Darla arriving
scenes.description: The fish learn a rough child named Darla is about to arrive and Nemo, panicked, calls for help and nearly slips out of the tank toward a dangerous fall before being calmed down.

scenes.title: Marlin and Dory chased by pelican
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory are suddenly startled by a large pelican swooping at them, fearing they will be eaten.

scenes.title: Wild shark ride to find Nemo
scenes.description: A shark offers to help Marlin and Dory, then they get a fast, scary ride through the ocean while Dory panics from the noise.

scenes.title: Darla catches Nemo, thinks he's dead
scenes.description: A rough little girl grabs Nemo in a bag and shakes him; the other fish think he has died before he plays dead to escape being flushed away.

scenes.title: Escape from the dentist's office
scenes.description: Chaos erupts as fish try to save Nemo from Darla and the dentist, with fish flying, a fish stuck in hair, and Nemo nearly getting hurt before being pushed down a drain to escape.

scenes.title: Marlin believes Nemo is gone, leaves Dory
scenes.description: Marlin, thinking his son is dead, gives up and decides to leave Dory, who begs him not to go and admits she needs him.

scenes.title: Marlin captured by gulls
scenes.description: Marlin is suddenly snatched up by seagulls while Nemo watches and calls out for him, and Dory cries out in distress.

scenes.title: Nigel realizes Nemo's alive
scenes.description: A pelican who thought Nemo had died is shocked to see him alive and threatens a crab for information about Marlin.

scenes.title: Reunion in the net
scenes.description: Nemo and Marlin are joyfully reunited, but they and other fish are caught in a fishing net and in danger.

scenes.title: Dory trapped, Nemo's plan
scenes.description: Dory gets caught in the net and screams for help; Nemo insists on swimming into danger to organize the trapped fish to swim down together to break free, worrying his father.

scenes.title: Nemo appears lifeless
scenes.description: Nemo floats motionless and appears not to be breathing, and Marlin fears his son has died before Nemo is revived.
